title: Jesus... I Thanked You Early And Felt Fake 🙏
topic: she thanked God in advance at church for the answer she has prayed about for eleven months, and felt like a fraud saying it

bible.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I thanked You in advance at church today. I felt fake. 🙏

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Same prayer. Eleventh month. And I stood there saying thank You like it had already come.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You weren't faking. You were trusting Me with nothing to see yet. That's the hard kind.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Thanking feels like lying when the door is still shut. What if it never opens, Jesus?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Thanking Me early isn't saying the pain is gone. It's saying you believe I'm still listening.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Keep thanking Me in the waiting. Not because it came, but because I'm still carrying it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend still praying the same prayer. 🙏
